instruction: Use ANSYS to maximize the first linear-buckling load factor per unit mass for the column defined in C:\Users\user\Desktop\problem_spec.json. For this task, open Mechanical APDL from `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\baseline_wb_buckling.db and its result file C:\Users\user\Desktop\baseline_wb_buckling.rst. Keep the column axis, length, material, pin-style end conditions, 1 N reference compression, BEAM188 formulation, analysis type, mesh, and uniform-section restrictions unchanged. Select one uniform RECT or HREC section within the published dimension, wall-thickness, and area limits. Solve the final design and save its native database as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.db and its buckling result as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.rst.
